mainEntity.name: Can I rent out my guest home for passive income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many areas, including those served by Zen Tiny Homes, you can rent out your guest home. Guest homes are increasingly popular for generating passive income, whether through long-term rentals or short-term vacation rentals, depending on local regulations. Renting out your guest home can help offset construction costs and increase property value. It's important to research specific short-term rental ordinances in your city, as rules can vary regarding length of stay, permits, and transient occupancy taxes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, guest homes can be rented for passive income through long-term or short-term leases, depending on local regulations. This can help offset costs and increase property value.
